description: The tables the 'Secure Record Owner' role must hold Read on, at User (Basic) depth, so that Dataverse accepts the Secure Record team as the OWNER of a row in that table. Dataverse refuses an owner whose roles lack Read on the table ('Read Privilege Check For Owner failed ... is missing prv<Read> privilege'). This file is the ONE list. SECURE-PROJECT-ENVIRONMENT-SETUP.md sections 5.1, 5.3, 5.4 and 7, scripts/Set-SecureRecordOwnerRolePrivileges.ps1 and unified-access-control-r2's NFR-05 census all read it. Do not copy it anywhere else.
howToExtend: Add a table ONLY when a writer assigns rows of it to the Secure Record team, or an owner decision requires it. State which in 'reason'.

Record the failure that forces it in 'evidence': create a probe row owned by the Secure Record team with the privilege missing, and quote the refusal. A NEW table without a recorded refusal does not belong here. (Two exceptions, each saying why in its evidence: sprk_document was already granted, so no refusal could be recorded; sprk_externalrecordaccess is required by a writer that ships before the probe write, so its evidence is the read-only privilege reading that shows the role lacks it.)

'privilegeName' is the Read privilege's name from metadata (EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='x')/Privileges, PrivilegeType eq 'Read'). The casing follows the schema name (prvReadsprk_Todo, not prvReadsprk_todo). The script checks it against metadata and refuses a mismatch.
Never add a depth or an access type here. The role grants Read at User (Basic) depth and nothing else, per SECURE-PROJECT-ENVIRONMENT-SETUP.md section 5.1.

tables.reason: Owner decision, unified-access-control-r2 round 102 item 4 (#2084, agreed with spaarke-ontology-platform-r1): a rule scoped to a matter (sprk_policy.sprk_matter) is that matter's child. When the matter turns Secure, SecureChildReconciler / SecureChildReconciliationJob re-own the rule to the Secure Record Owners team, so non-members no longer read the rule text or its link to the matter (D-123). A rule with no matter is never reached.

tables.reason: Owner decision D-11 (unified-access-control-r2 task 099b, #1010): an external-access grant row is owned by its root's team, never a user. GrantExternalAccessEndpoint.CreateGrantAsync (BuildGrantPayload) creates a grant on a secure project, matter or work assignment owned by the Secure Record Owners team, and SecureChildReconciler moves a root's grant rows to that team on Make Secure. Not a lineage child: no row is filed under a grant, and the share mirror never covers it.
